script: Listen to a conversation between a professor and a student.
Hello, Professor Denton. Are you free for a moment? Could I have a word with you?
Come on in, Michael. These are my office hours, so this is the right time to come and ask questions. How can I help you?
I have a quick question about tomorrow's homework. I thought we were supposed to answer the first three questions at the top of page sixty-seven, but there weren't any questions there. I'm confused.
The assignment was the first three questions at the top of page seventy-six, not sixty-seven.
Oh, now I understand. I'm glad I came in to check. Thanks for your help.
